sports.title: Jay Meena battled typhoid, hip injury & self-doubt to win historic Asian Games medal
sports.body: Weeks before the 2026 Asian Games, 25-year-old Jay Meena could barely climb a flight of stairs. Typhoid had left him eight kilograms lighter, bedridden and racing against time. In Nagoya, the 25-year-old overcame illness, injury and self-doubt to win India's first-ever Asian Games medal in Soft Tennis, completing an extraordinary journey that began with a school rustication.

sports.title: India to face Afghanistan in Asian Games quarter-final after Nepal-Japan game washed out
sports.body: The Indian men's cricket team is gearing up to take on Afghanistan in a pivotal quarter-final match during the Asian Games. Scheduled for September 28 in Nisshin, this knockout clash follows Nepal's impressive lead in Pool A, due to a rain-cancelled fixture with Japan. Both Afghanistan and Nepal will vie for a shot at the semi-finals, adding extra tension to this encounter.
